17364-types-of-weltschmerz-in-german-poe.title: Types Of Weltschmerz In German Poetry
17364-types-of-weltschmerz-in-german-poe.creator: Unknown
17364-types-of-weltschmerz-in-german-poe.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The purpose of the following study is to examine closely certain German authors of modern times, whose lives and writings exemplify in an unusually striking degree that peculiar phase of lyric feeling which has characterized German literature, often in a more or less epidemic form, since the days of "Werther," and to which, at an early period in the nineteenth century, was assigned the significant name "Weltschmerz."

arxiv-1601-03248.title: Covering a cubic graph by 5 perfect matchings
arxiv-1601-03248.creator: Wuyang Sun
arxiv-1601-03248.description: Abstract Berge Conjecture states that every bridgeless cubic graph has 5 perfect matchings such that each edge is contained in at least one of them. In this paper, we show that Berge Conjecture holds for two classes of cubic graphs, cubic graphs with a circuit missing only one vertex and bridgeless cubic graphs with a 2-factor consisting of two circuits.

arxiv-2211-03897.title: Fast Neutron Spectroscopy with a High-pressure Nitrogen-filled Large Volume Spherical Proportional Counter
arxiv-2211-03897.creator: I. Giomataris, I. Katsioulas, P. Knights, I. Manthos, J. Matthews, T. Neep, K. Nikolopoulos, T.Papaevangelou, B.Phoenix, R.Ward
arxiv-2211-03897.description: Abstract We present a fast neutron spectroscopy system based on a nitrogen-filled, large volume gaseous detector, the Spherical Proportional Counter. The system has been successfully operated up to gas pressure of 1.5 bar. Neutron energy is estimated through measurement of the 14 N(n,α) 11 B and 14 N(n,p) 14 C reaction products.

arxiv-2308-02578.title: Notes on noncommutative ergodic theorems
arxiv-2308-02578.creator: Semyon Litvinov
arxiv-2308-02578.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Semyon Litvinov. Given a semifinite von Neumann algebra ℳ \mathcal{M} equipped with a faithful normal semifinite trace τ \tau , we prove that the spaces L 0 ​ ( ℳ , τ ) L^{0}(\mathcal{M},\tau) and ℛ τ \mathcal{R}_{\tau} are complete with respect to pointwise, almost uniform and bilaterally almost uniform, convergences in L 0 ​ ( ℳ , τ ) L^{0}(\mathcal{M},\tau) .

arxiv-2405-09542.title: Hybrid Magnonic Reservoir Computing
arxiv-2405-09542.creator: Cliff B. Abbott, Dmytro A. Bozhko
arxiv-2405-09542.description: Abstract Abstract: Magnonic systems have been a major area of research interest due to their potential benefits in speed and lower power consumption compared to traditional computing. One particular area that they may be of advantage is as Physical Reservoir Computers in machine learning models.

arxiv-2410-22154.title: Steepest Growth in the Primordial Power Spectrum from Excited States at a Sudden Transition
arxiv-2410-22154.creator: David Wands
arxiv-2410-22154.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by David Wands. Sudden phase transitions during inflation can give rise to strongly enhanced primordial density perturbations on scales much smaller than those directly probed by cosmic microwave background anisotropies. In this paper, we study the effect of the incoming quantum state on the steepest growth found in the primordial power spectrum using a simple model of an instantaneous transition during single-field inflation.

arxiv-2411-04869.title: Modelling of the atomic lines’ emission of fast moving pulsar nebulae
arxiv-2411-04869.creator: I.N. Nikonorov, M.V. Barkov, M. Lyutikov
arxiv-2411-04869.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by I.N. Nikonorov, M.V. Barkov, M. Lyutikov. Bow shocks generated by pulsars moving through weakly ionised interstellar medium (ISM) produce emission dominated by non-equilibrium atomic transitions. These bow shocks are primarily observed as H α \alpha nebulae. We developed a package, named Shu , that calculates non-LTE intensity maps in more than 150 spectral lines, taking into account geometrical properties of the pulsars’ motion and lines of sight.

arxiv-2412-00321.title: Observed Steep and Shallow Spectra, Narrow and Broadband Spectra, Multi-frequency Simultaneous Spectra, and Statistical Fringe Spectra in Fast Radio Bursts: Various Faces of Intrinsic Quasi-periodic Spectra?

britannica-1911-st-amand-mont-rond.title: St-Amand-Mont-Rond (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-st-amand-mont-rond.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-st-amand-mont-rond.description: Article 'St-Amand-Mont-Rond' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 23), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. of an arrondissement in the department of Cher, 39 m. of Bourges on the railway to Montluçon. The town stands at the foot of the hill of Mont-Rond on the right bank of the Cher, at its confluence with the Marmande and on the canal of Berry. A church of the period of transition from the Romanesque to Gothic style and several old houses are the more interesting buildings.

pmc-10586031.title: Activation of mTORC1 Signaling Cascade in Hippocampus and Medial Prefrontal Cortex Is Required for Antidepressant Actions of Vortioxetine in Mice
pmc-10586031.creator: Wei-Yu Li, Tian-Shun Shi, Jie Huang, Yan-Mei Chen, Wei Guan, Bo Jiang, Cheng-Niu Wang
pmc-10586031.description: BackgroundAlthough thought of as a multimodal-acting antidepressant targeting the serotonin system, more molecules are being shown to participate in the antidepressant mechanism of vortioxetine. A previous report has shown that vortioxetine administration enhanced the expression of rapamycin complex 1 (mTORC1) in neurons.

pmc-11290942.title: The prioritisation of curable sexually transmitted infections among pregnant women in Zambia and Papua New Guinea: Qualitative insights
pmc-11290942.creator: Lisa M. Vallely, Kelvin Kapungu, Alice Mengi, Mike Chaponda, R. Matthew Chico, Michaela A. Riddell, Andrew J. Vallely, William Pomat, Eva Cignacco, Nicola Low, Angela Kelly-Hanku, Md Nazmul Huda, Md Nazmul Huda
pmc-11290942.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Curable sexually transmitted infections (STIs) are neglected in public health policy, services and society at large. Effective interventions are available for some STI but seem not to be prioritised at global, regional or local levels. Zambia and Papua New Guinea (PNG) have a high burden of STIs among pregnant women but little is known about the prioritisation of STI treatment and care among this group.

pmc-11689409.title: MAXIMIZING THE SCALABILITY OF THE CHRONIC DISEASE SELF-MANAGEMENT PROGRAM AMONG OLDER ADULTS IN STATE PRISONS
pmc-11689409.creator: Rodlescia Sneed
pmc-11689409.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Incarcerated older adults have high rates of chronic disease; however, there is limited chronic disease programming in most state prison systems. The Chronic Disease Self-Management Program (CDSMP) is an evidence-based program that has been used within state prisons on a limited basis, but there has been little research into efficient and effective strategies for scaling up the intervention within state prisons.

pmc-12463893.title: A systems approach to creative flourishing: conceptual foundations and implications for development
pmc-12463893.creator: Cordele Glass
pmc-12463893.description: This article introduces the term “Creative Flourishing” defined as the experiential confluence of Creative Agency (one's drive to create), Creative Self-Efficacy (belief in one's creative ability), and Flow Proneness (the tendency to experience flow during creative activities) within an appropriate and responsive environment.

pmc-12695663.title: High-resolution imaging mass cytometry to map subcellular structures
pmc-12695663.creator: Alina Bollhagen, James Whipman, Ricardo Coelho, Viola Heinzelmann-Schwarz, Francis Jacob, Bernd Bodenmiller
pmc-12695663.description: Imaging mass cytometry (IMC) is a powerful multiplexed imaging technology used to investigate cell phenotypes and spatial organization of tissue in health and disease. The spatial resolution of IMC is presently at 1 µm, enabling the resolution of single cells and large subcellular compartments but not submicrometer intracellular structures.

pmc-12723845.title: Identifying challenges and enablers to engaging patients in preclinical laboratory research: an interview study
pmc-12723845.creator: Madison Foster, Dean A Fergusson, Emily Thompson, Victoria Hunniford, Talston Scott, Stephen Daniels, Dawn P Richards, Pat Messner, Kathryn Hendrick, Patrick Sullivan, Asher A Mendelson, Kimberly F Macala, Kirsten M Fiest, Angela M Crawley, Bernard Thébaud, Stuart G Nicholls, Cheryle A Séguin, Grace
pmc-12723845.description: BackgroundPatient engagement in research enriches study design, conduct, and dissemination by integrating lived experiences of patients into the research process. Although patient engagement is becoming more popular in clinical research settings, it remains comparatively rare in preclinical (i.e. laboratory based) research.

pmc-12733642.title: Analysis of Microbial Community Structure and Cultivation Performance Assessment in Tremella fuciformis Liquid Inoculum
pmc-12733642.creator: Hui Lin, Qi Xiong, Wenxuan Huang, Xinghua Dai, Yingxi Yang, Wenlin Huang, Shufang Lai, Shujing Sun, Liaoyuan Zhang, Ruilin Zhao
pmc-12733642.description: Liquid inoculum is widely adopted in the mushroom industry, yet preparing Tremella fuciformis liquid inoculum remains challenging due to its complex microbial community and dimorphic growth. This study aimed to establish a reliable protocol for T. fuciformis liquid inoculum and assess its practical application. Initially, liquefied spawn was produced by liquefying solid spawn.

pmc-12738764.title: Ecosystem carbon use efficiency at global scale from upscaling eddy-covariance data with machine learning and MODIS products
pmc-12738764.creator: M. Campos-Taberner, M. A. Gilabert, S. Sánchez-Ruiz, B. Martínez, A. Jiménez-Guisado, F. J. García-Haro
pmc-12738764.description: Carbon use efficiency (CUE) is a key indicator in coupled biological–abiotic systems that accounts for their capacity of effectively retain carbon, offering insights of ecosystem functioning and the dynamics of carbon cycle. Generally, CUE assessments have been limited to an autotrophic perspective, quantifying plant efficiency while neglecting carbon losses from heterotrophic respiration.

pmc-13067687.title: Mapping the evidence on factors influencing postpartum contraception among sub-Saharan African immigrant and refugee women in the United States: a scoping review
pmc-13067687.creator: Comfort Z Olorunsaiye, Augustus Osborne, Hannah M Degge, Ucheoma Nwaozuru, Sanni Yaya
pmc-13067687.description: BackgroundThe postpartum period is a critical window for addressing women’s contraceptive needs. Sub-Saharan African immigrant and refugee women living in the United State face unique barriers to postpartum contraception due to cultural norms, religious beliefs, migration-related challenges, and systemic inequalities, yet there is limited evidence on their postpartum contraceptive preferences and use.

pmc-13289537.title: Chitosan-loaded copper oxide nanocomposite as a promising antiviral alleviates Zucchini yellow mosaic virus infection in squash plants
pmc-13289537.creator: Eman A. Ahmed, Ahmed Shaaban, Khaulood A. Hemida, Mostafa M. Rady, Ahmed I. Ali, Amro A. Farrag

pmc-13321860.title: Investigating the Efficacy of Telerehabilitation in Individuals Who Underwent Hand Tendon Surgery: A Randomized Controlled Trial
pmc-13321860.creator: Zerrin İzmirli Mete, Ferruh Taşpınar, Yasemin Özkan, Betül Taşpınar
pmc-13321860.description: Hand tendon injuries require a long rehabilitation process. Telerehabilitation may offer advantages in terms of accessibility, time, and cost. Accordingly, this study aimed to determine the efficacy of telerehabilitation in individuals who underwent hand tendon surgery. This randomized controlled study comprised two groups: a home program group and a telerehabilitation group.

pmc-13451174.title: Design and development of a semi-automated solid target assembly for the indigenous production of medical radioisotopes in the PETrace-800 cyclotron
pmc-13451174.creator: Kanchan Kushwaha, Kavindra Pathak, Tejinder P. Sabharwal, Sunil Kamble, Arpit Mitra, Sudeep Sahu, Pravind Maletha, Nand Kishore Prasad, Manish Kumar, Sharmila Banerjee
pmc-13451174.description: BackgroundMolecular imaging enables the non-invasive visualization of physiological processes at the cellular and molecular levels and is central to diagnostic nuclear medicine. Among clinically important theranostic radionuclides, 64Cu and 111In are of particular interest due to their favourable decay characteristics and applications in radiopharmaceutical development.

pmc-13514978.title: Corneal Endothelial Safety and Intraocular Pressure Outcomes of MicroPulse Laser Trabeculoplasty in Treatment-Naïve Glaucoma: A Six-Month Retrospective Study
pmc-13514978.creator: Ahmet Mehmet Somuncu, Ahmet Taner Uysal

pmc-13599102.title: Prolonged return to work and hampered work ability: insights from a scoping review on the impact of long COVID on healthcare workers job performance
pmc-13599102.creator: Pia Delano, Vicky Serra-Suton, Fernando G. Benavides, Mireia Utzet
pmc-13599102.description: BackgroundHealthcare workers (HCWs) may have a higher risk of developing long COVID due to greater exposure to COVID-19, with symptoms extending beyond the acute phase impacting their daily living activities and job performance.AimsTo systematically map the existing literature on the impact of long COVID on HCWs’ job performance, focusing on their time to return to work and work ability.

uslaw-usc-t15-s70g.title: 15 U.S.C. § 70g — Exclusion of misbranded textile fiber products
uslaw-usc-t15-s70g.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t15-s70g.description: United States Code, Title 15 (Commerce And Trade); Chapter 2 (Federal Trade Commission; Promotion Of Export Trade And Prevention Of Unfair Methods Of Competition); Subchapter V (Textile Fiber Products Identification). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. All textile fiber products imported into the United States shall be stamped, tagged, labeled, or otherwise identified in accordance with the provisions of section 70b of this.

uslaw-usc-t16-s698d.title: 16 U.S.C. § 698d — Review of Big Thicket Preserve area by Secretary; report to President
uslaw-usc-t16-s698d.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t16-s698d.description: United States Code, Title 16 (Conservation); Chapter 6 (Game And Bird Preserves; Protection). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Within five years from October 11, 1974, the Secretary shall review the area within the preserve and shall report to the President, in accordance with section 1132(c) and (d) of this title, his recommendations as to the suitability or nonsuitability of any area within.

uslaw-usc-t20-s1708.title: 20 U.S.C. § 1708 — Jurisdiction of district courts
uslaw-usc-t20-s1708.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t20-s1708.description: United States Code, Title 20 (Education); Chapter 39 (Equal Educational Opportunities And Transportation Of Students); Subchapter I (Equal Educational Opportunities); Part 3 (Enforcement). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The appropriate district court of the United States shall have and exercise jurisdiction of proceedings instituted under section 1706 of this title.
